## Summary

Describe the behavior/API change and why it belongs in the shared design system.

## Change type

- [ ] fix
- [ ] feature
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] docs
- [ ] test/tooling
- [ ] release/hotfix
- [ ] breaking change (migration notes included)

## Component/API impact

List affected public `D*` components, props, tokens, exports, or internal primitives.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] relevant interaction tests added/updated
- [ ] docs/examples updated when public behavior changes
- [ ] light/dark/custom tokens checked when styling changes
- [ ] overlay scroll/resize/portal behavior checked when floating UI changes
- [ ] no consumer-app/domain dependency introduced

## Compatibility

Explain whether existing consumers require changes. If breaking, include `BREAKING CHANGE:` details and link/update migration documentation.

## Manual verification

Describe the exact scenarios tested in the docs app or a representative consumer.
